task.title: Reorder sidebar projects by drag, and group them under collapsible categories
task.description: Dylan, 2026-10-08. Projects in the sidebar are fixed in import order. Make them click-and-drag reorderable, and add categories: a top-level group with an editable name that expands and collapses to hide the projects under it. Settled with Dylan: categories are created with a small New category control in the Projects header and named inline; projects drag into a category, out of it to the top level, and between categories; categories drag to reorder among top-level items; one level deep; projects outside any category stay at the top level; deleting a category returns its projects to the top level in place. Cmd+1 to Cmd+9 and Previous/Next Project follow the full sidebar order top to bottom, counting projects inside collapsed categories, so numbering never changes when a category folds. The Next view and every other list of projects follow that same order. Order, categories, names and collapsed state persist in the registry; a registry from an older build (no sidebar layout) reads as every project at the top level in its stored order; a project that is forgotten leaves the layout; an imported project appends at the top level. The collapsed rail shows categories as a labeled divider that honors the fold. Keyboard: arrow keys are not required this round, but the drag must have a visible drop indicator and must not fire a click on drop. No change to the sidebar head, the title strip or the board view; a separate task moves those.
